bulletReview.title: Review the rewrites
bulletReview.subtitle: Your wording is kept unless you accept a rewrite.
bulletReview.skipped_note_one: 1 line could not be rewritten and was left alone.
bulletReview.skipped_note_other: {{count}} lines could not be rewritten and were left alone.

reviewChanges.title: What changed
reviewChanges.subtitle: Review every change below. Nothing is saved to your documents until you approve it.
reviewChanges.incomparable: Your CV was pasted as plain text, so there is no structured version to compare against. Read the tailored CV itself before saving.
reviewChanges.nothing_changed: This tailoring did not change anything.
reviewChanges.save_hint: Nothing is written until you press this.

resumeScore.title: Resume quality
resumeScore.subtitle: How your CV reads on its own, before any job description. No job description needed.
resumeScore.generic_finding: A suggestion could not be displayed.
resumeScore.noFindings: Nothing to flag. This reads well.

contact.missing_email: Add an email address. Recruiters contact almost everyone they reject.
contact.missing_phone: Add a phone number. Many employers in Cameroon call before they email.
contact.missing_linkedin: Add a LinkedIn link if you have one. It is often the first thing an agency checks.

structure.missing_summary: Add a short summary at the top. It is the only part some recruiters read in full.
structure.missing_experience: Add an experience section, or rename an equivalent one if you use a different heading.
structure.thin_bullets: Your most recent role has very few bullet points. One or two lines read like a job description rather than achievements.
structure.missing_education: Add your education, even if briefly.
structure.missing_skills: Add a skills section with at least three skills.

impact.no_bullets: No achievement bullets were found. Check that your experience entries are written as bullet points.
impact.none_quantified: None of your {{total}} bullets include a number. Results are what get remembered: teams, percentages, money, time saved.
impact.few_quantified: Only {{count}} of your {{total}} bullets include a number. Aim for most of them.

verbs.no_bullets: No achievement bullets were found to check for action verbs.
verbs.weak_openers: {{count}} of your {{total}} bullets start with a weak word such as "responsible for" or "helped". Start with the verb instead.
verbs.few_strong: Only {{count}} of your {{total}} bullets start with a strong action verb such as "led", "built" or "reduced".

brevity.empty: There is no text to measure yet.
brevity.too_short: This CV is {{words}} words. Under {{target}} it is hard to show what you have done.
brevity.over_target: This CV is {{words}} words. Over {{target}} it usually spills past one page.
brevity.too_long: This CV is {{words}} words, well past the one-page mark. Cut the oldest roles back to one line each.

language.no_sentences: There is no text to read yet.
language.long_sentences: Your sentences average {{avg}} words. Keep them under 25 so a skimming reader can follow them.
language.mostly_long: {{count}} of your {{total}} sentences run past 35 words. Split them in two.

latex_preview_hint: LaTeX templates are typeset by a real TeX engine, so the PDF differs slightly in line breaks from this preview. The Word file always uses a Word template.
